name: Nick Kyrgios
rankNote: outside the live top 20; on the roster as Ryan's pick (Nov 9 2026)
era: 2022, his best-known season (Wimbledon final): cap worn backwards, red cap and red shoes as a statement
signature: tall, loose-limbed showman with a cap worn backwards and a fast, hard-to-read serve with a low toss; trick shots (tweeners, underarm serves)
exaggerate: cap turned backwards with the brim bent up
red accents (cap, shoes) where the court allows them
very quick, compact service motion with a low toss
source: personality and looks: public media, one link per claim in `sources` (Nov 9 2026); height (about 1.93 m) and hair are general knowledge and still need to be checked; outfits wait on stills (#18) Body numbers added Nov 11 2026 from the 2026 ATP media guide where the player is listed, otherwise the source named in body.

grass.notes: All-white dress code, cap worn backwards. Red shoes were a post-match gesture, not the in-point kit.

hard.notes: 2022 statement look already in this file: cap backwards, red cap and red shoes. A specific US Open shirt colour was not sourced; black is the field behind the red cap. Hex approximates those colour names.

clay.notes: He rarely plays clay. Cap stays backwards; other colours are the neutral default.

personality.temperament: entertainer and rebel: plays to the crowd, argues with umpires, talks to his own box during matches
personality.style: huge, hard-to-read first serve (quick motion, low toss) and trick shots
mannerisms: talks, shouts or complains to his player box between points
celebrations: showboating after trick shots, gestures to the crowd
personality.notes: underarm and between-the-legs (tweener) serves are well documented: an AI serve option for him, like Bublik
toConfirm: quick serve routine with few bounces
big forehand and sudden drop shots

sources.claim: underarm-tweener serve and showboating at the 2022 Australian Open ('It's a circus!')
the best underarm server on tour (Mouratoglou)
serve is hard to read: quick motion and relatively low toss
2022 Wimbledon final: talked to his box; backwards cap with the brim bent up in warm-up
red cap and red shoes at Wimbledon 2022 ('Because I do what I want')
tweener, leaping winner and a bottle thrown towards the umpire (Citi Open)

reachM.note: Same formula as bodyStats() in index.html. Not a measured wingspan. datasets/players/<id>/body.json does not exist yet (Body Scout has not run).

letRate.note: Same range already used for Sinner (0.02) and Alcaraz (0.03): lets on roughly 1–3% of pro serves. Not counted from a match log.

skills.scale: 1–20, 10 = neutral, the Skills Coach scale in src/skills/skills.js
skills.note: Not a measured rating. Set from the published style already in this file (serve size, footspeed, touch) so the locker room is not all 10s.

torsoScale.note: look.torso in src/players/roster.js is a pixel width multiplier taken from words already in signature/exaggerate (lanky, broad, slim). It is not a measured shoulder width.

favouriteServes.summary: Fast first serve with a low toss; underarm serve as a surprise.
favouriteServes.from: signature and the existing sources in this file
